questions.question: Which prophet told Ahab the truth that he would die in battle?
How did Ahab die?
options: Wounded by his own commander in the camp
Cut down by Aramean soldiers at the gate
Thrown down from his chariot during the retreat
Struck by an arrow shot "at random" in battle
questions.answer: Struck by an arrow shot "at random" in battle

questions.question: Ahab disguised himself in battle, but was killed anyway.
The prophet _____ alone prophesied disaster, while the false prophets promised victory.
A man drew his bow at random and struck Ahab between the joints of his _____.
